DeterminationBasis: Existing T05 controls govern provenance, admissibility, integrity, stable identity, trust boundaries, signature verification basis and evidence sufficiency, but no existing T05 control requires confidentiality protections to be preserved without destroying the inspectability required by the declared claim. A distinct confidentiality-versus-claim-inspectability control is therefore required.

Existing T16 controls preserve insufficient evidence and block stronger claims under NOT_ESTABLISHED states, but no existing T16 control specifically requires a verifier's inability to examine a material dependency to be preserved as either a scope limitation or NOT_ESTABLISHED condition. A distinct verifier-limitation preservation test is therefore required.
